raw_query: Show me United's matches from last season.

sport.basis: System-wide default: this project currently only supports football (see README.md). Used only because nothing in the raw query implies a different, unsupported sport.

required_fields.basis: Default core-outcome field set when unspecified — see docs/research-request.md § Defaults.

verification.basis: Default verification requirement when unspecified — see docs/research-request.md § Defaults.

output_format.basis: Default output format when unspecified — see docs/research-request.md § Defaults.

clarifications_needed.question: Which club named 'United' do you mean — e.g. Manchester United, Newcastle United, West Ham United, or Leeds United?
clarifications_needed.reason: 'United' matches multiple well-known football clubs and the request does not disambiguate which one; guessing one would silently narrow the request.

clarifications_needed.question: Which season do you mean by 'last season'? Please give an explicit season, e.g. '2023-2024'.
clarifications_needed.reason: 'Last season' is relative to an unstated reference date, and there is no documented rule in this project for resolving relative season references to a concrete season.
